title: TableRoute
summary: TableRoute is a paper-oriented, standalone and reproducible codebase implementing TABLEROUTE, an elastic capability-aware routing framework for scalable Table Question Answering over WikiTQ, WTQ-L, and BirdQA. Its requirements.txt lists sdv, ctgan, copulas, and sdmetrics as dependencies, but no code in the repository calls or references any of them.
evidence: requirements.txt: sdv==1.17.0, ctgan==0.10.1, copulas==0.11.1, sdmetrics==0.16.0 (no matching code usage found)
needs: No code call sites were found for any SDV-family package; unclear whether these are used at all in the TableQA routing pipeline described in the README.
